name: Els Angels & Rocacorba Double
description: The double-header. Els Angels first, then across to Banyoles and up Rocacorba — 68 miles and 2,000m of climbing. A proper Girona day.

name: Els Angels, Rocacorba & Mare de Déu del Mont
description: The Girona triple crown in one ride. Els Angels, Mare de Déu del Mont, Rocacorba, and back to Girona. Not a day for half measures.

name: Hincapie Loop — Baix Empordà & Gavarres
description: The George Hincapie loop. Els Angels, then south through the medieval villages of Monells, Peratallada, and Santa Pellaia. Quiet roads through cork oak forests.

name: Els Angels & Medieval Villages
description: 52km from Girona's stone bridge up Els Angels then rolling through Baix Empordà's medieval villages. The ride that makes Girona Girona.

name: Gavarres Gravel — River Ter & Els Angels
description: 70km gravel loop through the Gavarres. River Ter valley, Baix Empordà fire roads, Montnegre tracks, and the climb up to Els Angels on dirt. Where the disciplines blur.

name: Rocacorba via Banyoles
description: The classic approach to Rocacorba from Girona via the Banyoles lake road. The climb everyone benchmarks against.
